title: Senior Backend Engineer - (Kotlin, Spring, AWS) - Better Places (d/f/m)
description:
WHAT IS WORKING AT BETTERMILE LIKE?

- We mean it when we say “cutting edge” and have a high level of creative freedom in our everyday work

- You will be surrounded by like-minded, driven, skilled, and highly motivated people who are keen to contribute to successful solutions

- We mean diversity, and we put it in numbers: 130+ people, 40 languages, 40% female (vs. ø26% in the tech industry), ø33 years of age, and yes, we do have Schlager-Fans among us

- We have a very supportive and appreciative working environment with a lot of autonomy, a flat hierarchy, and professional growth possibilities

- We work in a hybrid mode, with weekly team days for better collaboration and nurturing interpersonal connections. When onsite, we work in a modern, kid- and pet-friendly Better Space in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg

- Remote work from anywhere for up to 12 weeks in total per year

- 30 vacation days in a 5-day/week working model

- Kindergarten grant and a Company Pension scheme

- Regular team breakfasts, fitness & wellness classes, company runs, and other events. Fruits, snacks, drinks, and coffee with a variety of milk are a given - but yes, we have them

- Outstanding flexibility we are proud of - and, of course, the best colleagues in the world!

About the team:

Location services are at the heart of any delivery experience, and the Features team of Better Places tribe is building a world-class solution that integrates multiple providers to get accurate geocoding, enables geocode corrections, and serves relevant information about addresses worldwide. We use open-source and proprietary data and algorithms to build a highly scalable system that serves billions of requests yearly.

YOU WILL BE TAKING CARE OF

- Building and taking end-to-end ownership of new features across our Kotlin-based backend microservices

- Deploying features and scaling systems via Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

- Partnering with product owners, fellow engineers, and cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, clear blockers, and drive initiatives forward

- Jumping into a dynamic team environment to refine our engineering practices and actively shape a tribe and product transformation as we evolve our backend architecture for the future

- Looking beyond existing solutions to actively identify architectural bottlenecks and drive meaningful improvements

Our Tech Stack:

- Backend Services: Kotlin, Spring Boot, Relational Databases (PostgreSQL), AWS (ECS, SQS, Eventbridge, EC2), Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi)

YOU CHECK THESE BOXES

- A background in computer science and software engineering, including a minimum of 3 years of backend experience

- Proficiency in Kotlin or deep production experience in Java with a strong affinity for Kotlin, along with frameworks like Spring Boot and build tools like Gradle

- Skilled in architectural design, specifically building fault-tolerant, high-throughput distributed systems

- Hands-on cloud experience with AWS and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Pulumi

- A commitment to clean code and engineering best practices, including RESTful/API design, Git, and maintainable technical documentation

- A hands-on, data-driven mindset that actively builds new capabilities, challenges the status quo with clear evidence, and adds distinct, complementary perspectives to the team

- Proficiency in Business English

IT IS AWESOME IF YOU ALSO HAVE

- Hands-on experience with asynchronous programming using Kotlin Coroutines and reactive data streams (e.g., Flow, RxJava, Project Reactor)

- Practical know-how in taking ML models and productionizing them within backend services

- Knowledge or practical experience with geospatial data processing

TAKE YOUR CHANCE

Be a part of shaping a fast-growing industry and make an impact from day one. You’ll have the chance to take on responsibility early, with guidance and support from experienced mentors. We foster a learning culture, collaboration on equal footing

title: Online Dozent:in Digitales Projektmanagement & KI - remote, Teilzeit (15h/w)
description:
Die Digital Business Akademie (DBA) bereitet Quereinsteiger in einem intensiven 7-monatigen Vollzeitprogramm auf eine Karriere im digitalen Projektmanagement und in der KI vor.
Teilnehmer lernen mit führenden PM Tools wie Jira und Asana zu arbeiten, und setzen ihr Wissen in täglichen Praxisprojekten um. Wir bieten eine erstklassige Lernerfahrung und suchen engagierte Talente, die bereit sind, diese Herausforderung anzunehmen.
Unser Remote-First Kurs ermöglicht dir, flexibel von zu Hause zu arbeiten.
Aufgaben

•
Dozententätigkeit: Halte täglich engagierte und praxisnahe 1,5-stündige Vorlesungen zu den neuesten Tools und Methoden im Projektmanagement. Dabei greifst du auf unsere bereits fertigen Vorlesungsunterlagen zurück und reicherst erweckst diese mit eigenen Beispielen & Aufgaben zum Leben. Die Tätigkeit ist auf 15h pro Woche bemessen (täglich 9-12Uhr).

•
Lehrplan Entwicklung: Du feilst am bestehenden Curriculum sowie den zugehörigen Vorlesungen, Übungsaufgaben und dem Handbuch.

•
Teamführung: Du bildest die Spitze eines Teams mit 3 Tutor:innen, welche täglich nach der Vorlesung übernehmen und die Teilnehmenden bei der Praxisarbeit unterstützen. Du koordinierst dabei dein Tutoren-Team und bist mit ihnen im engen Austausch, um den Lernfortschritt jedes Teilnehmenden im Auge zu behalten.

•
Ownership: Du trägst die Verantwortung für das Abschneiden der Teilnehmenden in deinem Modul. Dementsprechend solltest du dynamisch auf den Fortschritt und das Tempo der Gruppe eingehen und nicht starr das Lehrkonzept durchziehen.

Qualifikation

•
Branchenkenntnis: Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Projektmanagement mit, kennst klassische und agile Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban und gehst sicher mit Tools wie Jira oder Confluence um.

•
KI-Kompetenz: Du verfolgst die neuesten KI-Tools und -Entwicklungen mit Begeisterung, setzt dich eigenständig damit auseinander und integrierst sie aktiv in deine Lehre.

•
Bildungsbegeisterung: Deine Passion liegt im Lehren und Entwickeln von Talenten, denen du die Welt des Projektmanagements näherbringst.

•
Führungserfahrung: Du hast idealerweise in vorherigen Rollen ein Team geleitet oder bedeutende Projektverantwortung getragen.

•
Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist ein hervorragender Redner, der täglich fesselnde und interaktive Vorlesungen gestaltet und dabei eigene Praxiserfahrungen einbringt.

•
Deutschkenntnisse: Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachlerniveau.

Benefits

•
Spürbarer Impact: Du hast einen spürbaren Einfluss auf das (Arbeits-)Leben unserer Teilnehmenden und. Das ist sehr erfüllend, wenn der Plan aufgeht.

•
Startup-Dynamik: Dich erwartet bei uns ein hoch motiviertes und junges Team, welches sich mit der Mission voll identifiziert. Im remote Setup hast du viel Freiraum bei der Unterrichtsgestaltung. Gleichzeitig trägst du viel Verantwortung in der Schlüsselposition als Dozent.

•
Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld: Gestalte deinen Unterricht flexibel im Home Office und genieße die Freiheiten unseres Remote-Setups.

Wenn der Job für Dich interessant klingt, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf. Bitte teile uns außerdem kurz mit, wann Du frühestmöglich anfangen könntest.

title: Technical Founder's Associate (Berlin, on-site)
description:
sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training.

We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today.

Join us and play a pivotal role in transforming the automation landscape in heavy industries.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a hands-on Founder's Associate to work directly with our founders in Berlin. This role suits a recent graduate who combines quantitative and economic thinking with real technical ability - the kind of person who can size a market in the morning, pull the numbers themselves in the afternoon, and spend the next day in the workshop or on-site getting hardware onto a machine. A meaningful part of this job is physical: moving machines, equipment, and hardware. You will do the work rather than coordinate it.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own high-priority projects end to end on behalf of the founders, from customer pilots and field deployments to internal tooling and process automation.

- Get hands-on with hardware - preparing and assembling sensor and compute kits, moving machines and equipment, and supporting installation, testing, and demos on-site.

- Build the analysis behind key decisions - unit economics, pricing, market sizing, and machine performance data - pulling and cleaning the data yourself.

- Prepare material for investors, grant programmes, and customers, and work across engineering, commercial, and operations teams to unblock execution.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field - a combination of the above is ideal.

- Able to ship working software with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor - scripts, prototypes, and automations - with enough Python and SQL to review, debug, and trust what comes out.

- Valid category B driving licence, and the willingness to drive to customer sites, transport equipment, and move machines and hardware.

- Evidence of getting things done without supervision - a startup, a side project, a student venture, or a demanding internship.

- Based in Berlin (or willing to relocate), happy to work on-site, and comfortable spending time in a workshop and around heavy machinery in operation.

PREFERRED SKILLS:

- Practical workshop experience - wiring, mechanical assembly, prototyping, or vehicle work, whether from a robotics team, Formula Student, or personal projects.

- Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, machine learning, or industrial hardware.

- Experience operating vans, trailers, forklifts, or heavy equipment, or a willingness to be trained.

- Practical experience building internal tools, dashboards, or automations with modern AI tooling.

- Working knowledge of German, and interest in customers in mining, construction, or heavy industry.

WHAT WE OFFER:

- Build physical AI for the world's largest off-highway machinery - making them intelligent, safe, and ready for every tough task

- Join the pioneer in intelligent robotics backed by Point Nine & other Tier 1 investors

- Combine cutting-edge robotics research in end-to-end learning & Vision Language Action Model with real-world heavy mobile equipment

- Tailor your own career path, whether you like to become technical specialist or technical team lead

- Experience a great team culture, beverages, and an amazing office environment

BENEFITS:

- Attractive compensation package and stock options.

- Beverages on-site and regular social events.

- Engage with top-tier researchers, engineers, and thought leaders.

- Influence the future of robotic technologies and tackle significant technological challenges.

- Assistance with relocation to Berlin.

title: Бухгалтер
description:
У команду фінансів, що супроводжуватимуть напрям зеленої енергетики, дочірніх компаній «Київстару», шукаємо фахівця/-чиню, що відповідатиме за ведення бухгалтерського обліку, роботу з первинною документацією та взаєморозрахунки з контрагентами.
Що треба робити?
Створювати та проводити первинні вхідні й вихідні бухгалтерські документи.
Реєструвати вхідні податкові документи, погоджувати з контрагентами та реєструвати вихідні податкові накладні.
Контролювати розрахунки з контрагентами, складати акти звірок та акти взаємозаліків зустрічних вимог.
Комунікувати з контрагентами з питань взаєморозрахунків та документообігу.
Вести реєстр розрахунків і підтримувати базу електронних документів з ДП «Гарантований покупець» та НЕК «Укренерго».
Контролювати електронні кабінети НЕК «Укренерго», ДП «Гарантований покупець» та Оператора ринку.
Брати участь в інвентаризаціях.
Нараховувати заробітну плату та вести кадровий облік.
Формувати реєстр платежів і погоджувати його відповідно до внутрішніх процедур компанії.
Вносити платіжні інструкції та вивантажувати банківські виписки.
Підтримувати головного бухгалтера в поточних операційних завданнях: закритті місяця, підготовці відповідей на запити аудиторів, колег, інших департаментів, контролюючих органів, регулятора та контрагентів.
Брати участь у підготовці драфтів податкової та статистичної звітності.
Ви - наш метч, якщо...
Маєте досвід роботи бухгалтером та добре орієнтуєтесь у бухгалтерському та податковому законодавстві України
Впевнено працюєте з BAS, Медок, Вчасно та Excel або Google Sheets
Маєте досвід роботи з електронним кабінетом платника податків
Уважні до деталей, відповідальні та маєте аналітичне мислення
Вмієте організовувати свою роботу та ефективно працювати з великим обсягом задач
Це не обов’язково, але дуже цінно
Маєте досвід роботи з МСФЗ або зовнішньоекономічною діяльністю
Працювали з енергетичними компаніями або подібними ринками
Чому Київстар
Гнучкий графік роботи, гібридний формат
Бонуси за досягнення цілей (річні чи квартальні - залежить від ролі)
340+ внутрішніх курсів, власна бібліотека, навчальні програми від партнерів
Страхування життя і здоров’я
Програми підтримки працівників та їхніх родин: психологічні, юридичні та ін
Безбар’єрний простір для роботи та розвитку
Проєкти на підтримку захисників, ветеранів та їхніх родин

title: Roo Experience Concierge (RXC)

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.

The Roo Experience Concierge is the frontline ambassador for ensuring exceptional experiences across the Roo platform. When hospitals or veterinary professionals encounter issues, you step in with empathy, clarity, and action.

Your goal: turn challenging moments into opportunities for trust and long-term engagement.

You’ll balance relationship management and operational problem-solving - coordinating follow-up shifts, managing communication between both sides, and ensuring every recovery feels seamless and personal.

• Plan, execute, and monitor programs and projects to ensure delivery on time, within scope, and within budget.

• Coordinate internal partners across pillars, regions, and programs to define program scope, objectives, timelines, and success measures.

• Coordinate cross-functional and external partners, serving as a primary point of contact for program operations.

As the primary advocate for the customer, the TPO works closely with UI/UX architects, developers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality, value-driven product releases.

This role is responsible for guiding the product lifecycle from concept to launch and beyond, ensuring that user needs are met while maintaining technical integrity. • Act as the primary contact for major system issues and product-related inquiries.

• Gather and document requirements from clients and internal stakeholders.

• Manage and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring readiness for development.

• Lead Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, sprint reviews, and other team meetings.

• Collaborat closely with developers and QA to ensure product quality, accurate implementation, and smooth releases.

Manual Testing Team Oversight

• Aligned testing timelines with product delivery schedules.

• Ensured regulatory compliance and managed escalations.

• Coordinated with Reg-ent and leadership, delivered financial reporting, and trained new staff on MIPS-related tasks.

• Experience in the healthcare or health technology industry related to medical practices

• Demonstrated ability to manage conflicting priorities, distinguish between critical roadblocks and distractions, and make sound decisions under pressure.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
Description
Nebius Academy is a global AI education platform dedicated to empowering individuals and organizations to master artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI .
Nebius Academy combines deep technical expertise with a vision for AI-powered education, supporting both individuals aiming to upskill for new career paths and companies pursuing innovation at scale. Through a vibrant global community, Nebius Academy bridges the skills gap and accelerates the responsible adoption of AI, ensuring that both professionals and organizations are equipped to lead in an era of constant technological change.
What you will do

• Build and evolve our Internal Developer Platform , helping engineering teams move from merge request to production faster and more reliably.

• Own and develop our monorepo , keeping applications, shared libraries, and infrastructure coherent as the codebase and engineering organization grow.

• Build and improve CI/CD pipelines , including incremental builds, automated deployments, and tooling that makes shipping software simpler and faster.

• Automate the creation and setup of new services, including infrastructure, Helm charts, alerts, dashboards, and deployment pipelines .

• Build internal tools and automations that improve developer experience and engineering productivity across product teams.

• Treat engineers as your users: identify what slows them down, gather requirements, and turn those problems into scalable platform solutions.

• Measure and improve build times, deployment duration, performance, and reliability , fixing root causes rather than symptoms.

• Codify engineering conventions through linting, type checks, CI gates, and automation instead of relying on manual processes.

• Work hands-on across application code and infrastructure , using technologies such as Python, Go, AWS, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Postgres, Kafka, and Grafana.

• Work closely with SRE, QA, and product engineering teams on reliability, observability, performance, and quality.

• Make pragmatic architectural decisions and evaluate trade-offs around scalability, maintainability, developer experience, and delivery speed .

Requirements

• 5+ years of engineering experience. Python preferred; real depth in Java, C#, Kotlin or Go is a heavy plus. Ideally, you are comfortable with Python alongside at least one other backend language.

• Understanding and production experience with Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Docker, AWS and CI systems.

• Deep understanding of product development - how teams plan, ship, maintain, and troubleshoot features.

• A track record of building tooling and pipelines other engineers rely on, and real care for developer experience .

• Performance work grounded in measurement - metrics, traces and query plans rather than intuition.

• Architectural judgement in trade-offs rather than rules , avoiding both early overengineering and painted-in corners.

• Comfort in a large shared repository, and clarity about its trade-offs.

• Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy - clarify ambiguous requirements, identify what needs to be done, propose solutions, and take ownership through implementation rather than relying on detailed task specifications.

• Agile ways of working, and real investment in team processes, mentoring, and collective growth.

• A strong learning and team mindset : curiosity, willingness to grow beyond your current area of expertise, and readiness to contribute where it creates the most value for the team.

• Fluent Russian, and English at B2 level or above .

What we can offer you

• A supportive and proactive work environment.

• Competitive compensation: 5000-7000 USD Gross per month

• Fully remote and full-time collaboration.

• Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.

• Tangible results measured by student success.

title: Senior Product Quality Analyst - AI Voice
description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective - including voice type, age and gender - and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.
As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?
 

The United States base range for this position is $114,486-$163,552 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

title: Purchasing Analyst
description:

We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors-industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking an accomplished Purchasing Analyst to serve as the primary contact for Builder purchasing teams and a right-hand to the VP of Purchasing as we build out and scale this program.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're launching this program from the ground up! You'll develop the tools you need to assist with this work. Expect to:

- Manage the rebate, discount, and incentive process and payments with Builders and Suppliers for the Purchasing Program

- Work with Higharc Product and Procure team to facilitate programming

- Homebuilding experience

title: Fullstack Engineer, RL Environments
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Studio is one of Mercor's highest-priority initiatives. It is the internal platform that powers every workflow our teams use to generate, manage, quality-review, and deliver data to the world's leading AI labs - and its quality directly shapes the frontier models that billions of people interact with.

As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer on the Studio Experience team, you'll own the Studio user journeys end-to-end: the React frontend used daily by thousands of expert contributors and internal Strategic Project Leads, and the backend services powering data pipelines and delivery of outputs to customers. You'll also build and maintain the foundational layer that Mercor depends on to rapidly deploy new data types and task formats across the company. Four distinct stakeholders - AI labs, SPLs, expert contributors, and engineers- rely on what you build.

This is a role for someone who cares equally about engineering craft and product impact: shipping scalable, reliable systems and intuitive interfaces that make everyone who touches Studio faster and more effective.

YOU WILL

- Own the Studio platform across the full stack - from contributor-facing and operator-facing React interfaces to the backend APIs and pipelines driving data ingestion, QA review, and AI lab delivery.

- Lead engineering best practices across the team, setting the bar for frontend architecture, component design, and performance, and establishing patterns that others can build on reliably.

- Build the foundational layer that other teams depend on to support new data types, task formats, and customer configurations quickly and without rework.

- Ship high-leverage product features that improve throughput and quality across our core data generation and delivery pipelines.

- Translate ambiguous requirements into well-scoped technical solutions through close collaboration with Applied AI researchers, product, design, and operations.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of fullstack engineering experience building and shipping production software.

- Deep proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript (React + Next.js) and a strong grasp of frontend architecture, state management, and design patterns.

- Solid backend experience in Python and/or Node.js - experience designing and building relational databases, REST APIs, and async task infrastructure.

- Strong design sense and empathy for end-users; you hold a high bar for usability.

- Experience with complex, high-throughput systems - pipelines, large data volumes, or multi-tenant architectures.

- High ownership mindset; able to navigate ambiguity and drive projects from design through delivery.

- Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical and product tradeoffs clearly.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience building tooling for data labeling, annotation, or human-in-the-loop AI workflows.

- Background in design systems, developer-facing APIs, or internal platform engineering.

- Exposure to AI tools

title: Neuroscience PhD / ML Engineer
description:
About the Role
This is a founding-team research and engineering position at a seed-stage, Y Combinator-backed startup building a wearable device that infers and interprets real-time emotional states. The company is early - prototypes are already on users' wrists - and this hire is expected to own and ultimately lead the core inference work as the team scales.
The role sits at the intersection of computational neuroscience and production machine learning. You will be the primary person responsible for the model that quantifies emotional states from wearable sensor data, and you are expected to carry that work from research through to deployment.
What You'll Do

• Design, develop, and iterate on the inference model that quantifies emotional states from multimodal wearable sensor signals (audio, biometric, and others).

• Bridge neuroscience research - including frameworks such as active inference - and production-grade ML systems.

• Collaborate closely with hardware and product team members to integrate the model into the wearable pipeline.

• Take ownership of model performance, versioning, and deployment as the product moves toward broader release.

• Help define the scientific and engineering roadmap for the inference layer as the company grows.

What We're Looking For
Required

• PhD in computational neuroscience, cognitive science, active inference, or a closely related field.

• Demonstrated experience bridging neuroscience research and production machine learning systems - you can take a model from theory to deployment.

• Strong Python proficiency for ML model development and deployment.

• US work authorization required (visa transfers considered; new visa sponsorship is not available).

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience with active inference or predictive coding frameworks.

• Background working with wearable or physiological sensor data.

• Comfort operating as both a researcher and an engineer in a fast-moving, small team.

Not a Fit

• Wet-lab-only neuroscience backgrounds without computational or ML components.

Compensation & Benefits

• Base salary: ~$150,000 USD (or equivalent ~GBP 75,000 for London-based candidates)

• Equity: Meaningful founding-team equity (up to 1-2%) commensurate with the seniority and founding nature of the role.

Location
Primary office locations are London, UK and San Francisco, CA, USA . The team is open to remote or hybrid arrangements in addition to on-site. Location is flexible for the right candidate.

Director, Infrastructure Supply Chain Accounting

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a Director, Infrastructure Supply Chain Accounting to lead accounting for the components and integrated systems flowing through Anthropic's compute stack - from chips and networking hardware through racks and data center buildouts - underpinning our $50B+ investment in American computing infrastructure. As we continue our rapid growth, you will help ensure the operational scalability and financial accuracy of the core functions that enable Anthropic's research and commercial success.

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of one of the fastest-scaling companies in the industry, and to shape how Anthropic's growing fixed asset base is accounted for and understood across the business.

You will own end-to-end accounting and set the strategy for scaling the supply chain accounting function, working closely with cross-functional partners across Data Center Operations, Real Estate, Finance, and Legal. You'll apply deep technical accounting expertise under ASC 360 - combined with cost accounting judgment on components that behave like inventory - and build the processes, controls, and systems that let this function scale.

Serve as a trusted finance partner to non-finance stakeholders - explaining the financial statement impact of their decisions in clear, simple terms they can act on

•
Design and scale systems, processes, and controls to support a rapidly growing fixed asset portfolio

•
Lead and mentor a team of accounting professionals focused on your portfolio

•
Serve as a key point of contact with external auditors on fixed asset accounting matters

•
Drive process improvements and automation, including leveraging AI tooling, to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of financial reporting

You may be a good fit if you

•
Have 12+ years of progressive experience in accounting, with operational experience at technology, manufacturing, or infrastructure-heavy companies

•
Hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or equivalent preferred

•
Possess strong technical accounting knowledge of ASC 360 (capitalization, useful lives, impairment, disposals), plus applied experience with cost accounting concepts - BOM-based costing, standard vs. actual, obsolescence and NRV analysis - in a supply chain context

•
Have experience managing a significant fixed asset or component / inventory portfolio in a high-growth environment

•
Demonstrate strong analytical abilities and comfort working with large, complex datasets

•
Have a track record of improving scalable financial processes in fast-moving environments

Have experience leading and developing teams of acco

title: Senior Staff Performance Engineer, Firefox
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The Mozilla Firefox Performance team is a community of engineers who care deeply about delivering the fastest browser possible. We are the team responsible for making all parts of the browser go fast.

Our team is geographically-distributed, and working in the open is the norm. We contribute to the code driving the Firefox browser on a number of platforms - Windows, Android, Linux, and macOS. Our focus is on finding and fixing things that slow down the browser as well as helping other teams write fast and reliable code to make Firefox excellent for users.

Do you value curiosity and enjoy finding a needle in a haystack? Do you approach problems by looking at the system as a whole? Do you want to help lead and shape the future of the Internet? Do you like making things blazingly fast? If so, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do:

• Write code and tests, build prototypes, tackle problems, profile and analyze performance bottlenecks

• Learn about a wide variety of problems and solutions across a large, complex, and evolving codebase

• Use several programming languages (e.g., C++, JavaScript, Kotlin, Rust, Python) and techniques to fix performance issues, with an emphasis on C++ and JavaScript

• Help to educate engineers on other teams about writing more performant code through code reviews, giving talks, implementing tooling, and/or writing documentation

• Independently define and drive actionable next steps from high level objectives

• Work with engineering teams across the organization to assist and lead performance efforts

• Shape the future of performance benchmarks, and set the proper priorities for the necessary improvements

• Develop strategies for the future of the Performance team and the Organization as a whole

• Work with driven, committed team members to help bring the Open Web to millions of people 

What you'll bring:

• BS/MS in CS, CE and  7+ years relevant experience

• A mastered understanding of programming in C++

• An understanding of programming in JavaScript

• You have  proven experience developing performance critical software

• You take an experimental and measured approach to solving problems (measurement, and using experiments to diagnose an issue or prove out a solution)

• Proven skill in debugging and analyzing performance bottlenecks, and using profiling tools to diagnose and fix issues (VTune, Xperf, other sampling based profilers)

• Experience with multithreading and concurrency, disk I/O, GPU

• Proven track record of setting team goals and driving them to completion.

• Experience motivating and aligning cross-functional teams to deliver on shared goals.

• An interest and ability to work in a distributed team (which requires good asynchronous written communication skills as well as good verbal communication skills)

Bonus points if you have any of the following:

• Familiarity with Web Standards or patterns

• Familiarity with Android or Windows OS application programming

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Let's get the tricky part out of the way. Legal Engineering does not fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines legal practice, product fluency, enterprise change, commercial judgement and client leadership.

As Head of Legal Engineering, Mexico, your mission is to establish Legal Engineering as the commercial and delivery engine for Mexico, anchored in Mexico City. You will set the craft bar, build the team and its Team Lead layer, partner closely with Go-to-Market and Engagement, lead selectively on the highest-stakes clients, and turn local learning into playbooks that scale across the market.

This is a Director-level leadership role. Your primary output will be the quality and performance of the team and system you build. You will stay close enough to the product and the work to coach credibly, while moving your own time toward hiring, leadership development, senior relationships, market strategy and cross-functional execution.

You will have the autonomy to shape how Legal Engineering lands in a strategically important market, together with the responsibility to keep that local model connected to Legora's global standards.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Some of what you will be up to:

- Stand up the Legal Engineering function for Mexico from the Mexico City office, including its operating rhythm, quality bar, capacity model and local partnership with Go-to-Market and Engagement.

- Hire exceptional Legal Engineers and future leaders. Own the quality bar from sourcing and interview calibration through closing, onboarding and ramp.

- Build a manager layer of Team Leads who each own and develop a group of Legal Engineers. Delegate real decision rights and create clear succession paths so the function becomes stronger and less dependent on you over time.

- Give direct, evidence-based feedback. Coach hard, set clear expectations and act decisively when the performance or values bar is not met.

- Partner with local commercial leadership on priority accounts, pilots, rollouts and escalations. Connect Legal Engineering activity to conversion, adoption, usage, expansion and revenue.

- Act as the lead legal architect on selected enterprise engagements. Translate a real legal problem into a concrete Legora workflow, then turn successful delivery into a reusable playbook others can run.

- Oversee complex, multi-stakeholder programmes with clear governance, owners, outcomes, leading indicators and risk management.

- Build trusted relationships with Managing Partners, General Counsels, Heads of Innovation, Legal Operations leaders and other senior stakeholders.

- Represent the market's voice inside Lego

FirstPrinciples is building AI to accelerate scientific discovery. Our core product is the Theo Platform, a research environment built to help researchers iterate faster, validate rigorously, and reach verified results they can trust.

 

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

 

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists:

We’re building AI systems at the frontier of scientific discovery, which means research is fundamental to our product advantage. But great research is not just about generating interesting ideas, it’s about directing our time, talent, and compute toward the work most likely to create meaningful scientific and product progress.

This role exists to bring strong product discipline to research execution. You’ll help researchers turn open-ended exploration into clearly framed bets, define how we measure progress and ROI, and create the operating rhythms that let us learn quickly. You’ll push promising work forward with urgency, surface weak signals early, and help teams change direction when an approach is no longer earning its investment.

Your impact will help Research maximize its pace in the organization - more ambitious in what it pursues, more rigorous in how it evaluates progress, and accountable for turning research investment into real product capabilities and breakthroughs.

- Partner with research leads to define clear research programs, priorities, hypotheses, milestones, and expected outcomes

- Operationalize and steward our Research Portfolio & ROI Framework - assessing research bets by ambition, uncertainty, impact, maturity, time horizon, confidence, cost, and product applicability at the program and portfolio level

- Establish stage-appropriate evidence plans, KPIs, and leading and lagging indicators for research projects, including signals that increase or reduce confidence, validate progress, or decisively kill a direction

- Create operating rhythms that increase the pace of Research: regular reviews, clear owners, intermediate deliverables, decision points, and tight follow-through

- Track research initiatives against their objectives and investment, keeping teams accountable for progress while preserving room for genuine scientific exploration

- Identify stalled projects, weak assumptions, and diminishing returns early, and drive explicit decisions to iterate, redirect, pause, or stop work rather than allowing projects to drift

- Connect research priorities to company, product, and technical strategy, ensuring the research portfolio reflects the capabilities and differentiated advantages we most need to build

- Translate research progress into clear decisions, implications, and tradeoffs for Product, Engineering, and leadership, while helping successful research transition into product capabilities, assets, or future strategic options

Who You Are:

- 5+ years as a product manager or program manager in technology or research organizations, comfortable operating in highly technical, ambiguous, and exploratory environments

- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related technical field; ensuring you can comfortably debate technical tradeoffs.

Partnering closely with the Director, Product Marketing, the Marketing Manager helps shape strategy for an emerging category while driving hands-on execution to build market awareness, strengthen customer confidence, and establish NeoGenomics as a leader in the MRD space.
Core Responsibilities

• Shape MRD strategy in partnership with the Director, ensuring product-level priorities ladder up to and inform the broader portfolio framework

• Identify the highest-opportunity areas within MRD’s patient populations, indications, and clinical use cases, informing where winnable position and go-to-market investment should concentrate

• Define a clear winnable position for MRD, informed by VOC, competitive intelligence, and portfolio expertise, and ensure it’s consistently reflected in positioning, messaging, and content

• Educate the market on MRD as a category, not just NeoGenomics’ specific offering, partnering with the Content and Thought Leadership Manager to translate emerging science into content that builds broader category understanding

• Set clear objectives and KPIs across MRD marketing initiatives, tracking performance to ensure the work is having its intended impact

• Execute marketing across MRD’s full lifecycle, from launch through market maturity, protecting, growing, and expanding share as appropriate to each stage, partnering with Commercial Launch Excellence on launch-specific readiness

• Write and produce core MRD marketing content and materials directly, partnering with Digital, Content, and Creative resources for broader execution needs

• Collect voice-of-customer insights for MRD, feeding both portfolio strategy and roadmap conversations with Product Management

• Track competitive intelligence specific to MRD, feeding the Director’s portfolio-wide competitive picture

• Build the AOP budget request for MRD based on the strategic plan, then manage and reallocate spend within the approved allocation based on performance

• Partner with the Oncology, Pathology, and Pharma Commercial Marketing Directors to ensure MRD’s product story translates into audience-specific narratives

title: Strategy Advancement Advisor
description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 100 health benefits company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention. It has transformed itself from the largest US nursing home company in the 60’s, to the largest US hospital corporation in the 80’s, to a leading health benefits company beginning in the 90’s. Today, Humana is a leader in consumer-focused health solutions and is one of the largest health benefits organizations in the country. Consumer Segment Team
Identifying and delivering new avenues of growth is a critical company priority. The Consumer Segment team is an entrepreneurial, multi-functional team within Humana ’s Enterprise Growth unit. The team is focused on driving industry leading membership growth, retention, and health outcomes by identifying new consumer insights, developing growth strategies, and activating them across the enterprise to serve the unique needs of prioritized segments.
Humana is seeking an experienced team member with meaningful strategy consulting or healthcare strategy experience to join this team. As a Strategy Advancement Advisor, you will support the development and implementation of consumer segment strategies that drive growth and retention while optimizing member experience and outcomes. You’ll collaborate with teammates and cross-functional partners to frame up business questions, conduct analyses, and recommend solutions. You will help answer key strategic business questions that arise during the annual product/sales cycle across multiple domains, including product design, plan footprint, marketing and sales performance, membership analytics, customer/provider satisfaction and more. You will proactively identify new consumer insights and create business cases to support new pilots and initiatives to address critical unmet consumer needs.
Key Responsibilities Include:

• Serving as a strategic and operational product manager for one or more projects, consumer segments, and/or innovative pilot, including but not limited to managing analyses and/or workstreams, such as Marketing, Sales, Digital and other go-to-market efforts

• Conducting industry/market analysis related to growth and competition, turning analyses into meaningful insights that will inform growth and product strategy

• Creating and owning the development of executive-level presentations and communications, including key deliverable updates and escalations.

• Being consumer obsessed through exploration of innovative new pilots, deepening insights through quantitative and qualitative consumer research, and simplifying/enhancing consumer and agent experiences

• Developing MA product framework that provides leaders with portfolio/plan level performance analysis

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of full-time relevant strategic work experience, ideally post-MBA

• Previous strategy experience in a healthcare or management consulting organization

• Strong leadership and stakeholder management, including the ability to build trust and credibility with senior business leaders and influence decision-making across the enterprise

• Experience leading complex, strategic initiatives in a large matrixed organization

• Superior problem-solving skills and the ability to perform complex qualitative and quantitative analyses to drive actionable insights

• Experience leveraging consumer insights to design and implement new products/services/solutions

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with demonstrated experience developing and delivering engaging and informative presentations at an executive level

• Highly collaborative, adaptable, and able to lead through ambiguity in a dynamic environment

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA, MPH, or other graduate degree

• Prior healthcare industry experience, preferably in the managed care of provider sector

title: Remote Online Notary Home Equity Closing
description:
At U.S. Bank , we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One.
Job Description

The primary responsibility of this role is to virtually close Home Equity loans for the state of Illinois directly at the customer’s request. Must be comfortable navigating transactions and provide exemplary customer service virtually. Process /prepare paperwork and signatures required to close Home Equity loans Interfaces with Home Equity closing team and other internal partners when needed to close loans. May assist in scheduling and coordinating closing date with customers. Formalizes application for loan approval and enters into the computer or central filing system. Determines process interaction needed to satisfy internal, regulatory and investor requirements. Initiates communication with customers/clients, staff, realtors, brokers, counsel, title companies, etc. to obtain needed documents. Documentation may include appraisals, title reports, credit reports, verifications, tax returns, financial statements, etc., necessary to complete the file and ensure compliance with internal and regulatory requirements; orders title search or other information, as might be necessary. Prepares required disclosure information within designated time frames ensuring compliance with all regulations. Provides loan status update to customers/clients or other interested parties, resolves discrepancies or problems and provides periodic status reports. Ensures quality customer service throughout the loan process. Reviews file and loan application after initial set up for accuracy and adherence to terms of approval. Reviews loan package to ensure all legal and compliance guidelines are adhered to. Assembles final loan package. Calculates and loan settlement statements. Disburses funds, enters closing information into the loan system and prepares final packages. Coordinates the entire loan package from closing to funding within designated time frames. Able to explain feature/benefit to customer at time of closing.

Basic Qualifications

Remote Online Notaries (RONs) must reside in or be physically present in the state where they are commissioned when performing notarial acts. This requirement ensures that the notary is operating within the jurisdiction that granted their commission and is subject to its laws and regulations. Residing in Illinois is required for this role.

Preferred Qualifications

Ability to work with legal to solve complex documentation needs

Knowledge of closing policies and procedures, funding policies, underwriting requirements, governmental and agency requirements, terminology and automated processing systems.

Strong organization skills as well as good verbal and written communication skills

Knowledge of applicable credit policies and approval processes for assigned product(s).

Highly preferred up to two years of relevant experience and a remote online notary license (RON).

Experience with LOS Applications Net Oxygen and/or BLEND

Experience working with Home Equity Loans and Lines of credit
